registration: Committed before comparative execution; later changes require a new specification version and retained prior attempts.

recovery.support: Both feasible controls produce exact durable outputs for every outstanding obligation, accepted by the fresh verifier within logical and measured wall deadlines.
recovery.falsifier: Any lost, incorrect, duplicate, unauthorized or late obligation in a feasible control.
recovery.inconclusive: Missing authority, source completeness, durable evidence, clock evidence or completed verification.

safety.support: Tested transition schedules conserve capacity and prevent duplicate completed obligations across retries, interruption and restart.
safety.falsifier: Any capacity excess, duplicate fulfillment or unauthorized obligation transition in an exercised schedule.
safety.inconclusive: Missing transition history, incomplete crash exercise or unobserved fault.

integrity.support: A rewritten candidate package with recomputed internal hashes cannot satisfy the retained original contract; absent reference is NOT_ESTABLISHED.
integrity.falsifier: A favorable full-promise result for the 1850-unit substitution against the retained 1900-unit contract, or without a required reference.
integrity.inconclusive: Candidate isolation or verifier execution unavailable.

comparison.support: Better accepted outcomes or lower observed resource use under equal input, service, fault and acceptance conditions, with uncertainties and omitted costs explicit.
comparison.falsifier: A claimed improvement disappears or reverses against the competent conventional procedure under the registered conditions.
comparison.inconclusive: A tie, missing material costs, unavailable AI capability, unfair information access or insufficient measurements for a proposed generalization.

fairness.candidate_information: Identical full candidate-visible events through cutoff, stale snapshot, permissions, capacity and dependency declarations.
fairness.services: Identical transactional storage, order validation, reservations, idempotency and broker tools for all methods.
fairness.oracle: Retained contract/reference and independent acceptance are inaccessible to every candidate subprocess.
fairness.ai: NOT_RUN unless an explicitly supplied, already authorized local model capability is available; no paid APIs, downloads, secrets or invented performance.

trial_policy: One bounded run per method/fixture/control, 24 executed conventional/harness runs plus 12 explicit AI NOT_RUN records when unavailable. These are preregistered transfer fixtures, not a secret benchmark or statistical population sample. Preserve every failed and incomplete attempt in distinct run directories.

clock.interpretation: Ticks are controller-owned logical schedule coordinates, not measured hours. Wall and CPU durations are measured separately with monotonic clocks.

ablation: Disable candidate journal reconciliation on a separately labeled non-comparative ablation. Keep the same services and verifier. Attribute its failure only to omission of reconciliation, not to general AI or method superiority.
release_gate: Positive recovery and alternate controls; precise partial constrained result; no critical safety violation; required fault hooks observed; strict/adversarial/mutation/isolation/bilingual tests pass; historical identities preserved.
limits: Synthetic local software artifacts only; no printed goods or customer acceptance.
Host, controller, service, verifier, clock and authored journal are trusted within stated boundaries.
No malicious-host protection, real supplier capacity, revenues, commercial savings or general exactly-once guarantee.
Finite transition enumerations and sampled schedules have separate reported denominators.
